errors.evidence: The task asks for the population difference between two specific county seats: – The county seat with the largest land area (by its city limits) – The county seat with the smallest land area (by its city limits)
errors.description: The agent misunderstood the task by focusing on the land area of the county seats instead of the city limits.

errors.evidence: The largest county seat by land area is Seattle (King County). According to the 2020 Census, Seattle’s population was 737,015.
errors.description: The agent assumed that the land area of the county seat is the same as the land area of the city limits.
The agent did not format the final answer correctly, as it should be an integer representing the difference between the populations.
